thesis: The site is the job folder opened on the tailgate: every section is one step in the dig, marked by a wooden grade stake with the surveyor's cut or fill notation, and scrolling turns the page from first stake to finished grade.

signature.name: Grade Stakes
signature.summary: A drawn wooden grade stake with orange flagging ribbon at the left margin (desktop) or top of each section (mobile), carrying a surveyor mark in mono type (C/F/R/0.0). Advances via --sw-p as sections enter view. Hook: data-sw-signature='grade-stake'.

palette.family: Night Soil + Survey Orange + Chert White

motion.intro: Photo fades in (800ms), headline rises onto bank (translateY 12px to 0, 400ms).
stories: Cross-section yard fills step by step as seven process steps scroll past (pinned, desktop only)
Rock clause slider animates ledge depth marker inline
motion.hover: Hairline rule grows from left edge via scaleX(0) to scaleX(1), 200ms, survey-orange.
